correctness.rationale: Exact M-matrix comparison proves nonincrease under identical susceptible/vaccinated mobility in arbitrary finite n. Full four-state DFE and F,W are reconstructed; rank-one perturbation of F0 with ||F0 W^-1||_infty<=3/41 yields the exact rho-crossing criterion. Exact determinant equals P(t)/(2000(31-19t)(31+19t)^2), and the cubic is strictly decreasing on [0,1] with exact opposite signs at 9/20 and 23/50. verify.py recomputes the critical identities.

value.rationale: The structural equal-mobility monotonicity theorem states a natural necessary modeling assumption under which increasing vaccination never raises reproduction number. The all-positive two-patch witness shows that altering only vaccinated travel violates this reliable control property despite positive 50% direct protection; a single exact algebraic crossover completely classifies invasion for a natural policy parameter. This separates direct biological efficacy from geographically shifted exposure, with use in mechanistic model sensitivity audits. No clinical/empirical claims.
